name: tibbs
description: Session continuity for Claude Code: rotates a long task into fresh conversations with a verified handover.

stateDir.title: State folder
stateDir.description: Absolute path where Tibbs keeps task state and handovers. Empty uses the OS default (macOS: ~/Library/Application Support/Tibbs). Never inside a repository unless you set it here.

autoRecover.title: Recover by itself
autoRecover.description: At session start, continue a task that an earlier session left interrupted (as /tibbs recover would), without asking. Off by default.
